name: cloud-manager-studio
description: Desktop toolbox suite for Adobe I/O Cloud Manager and App Builder

scripts.dev: npm run build:electron && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron dist-electron/electron/main.js"
scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron
scripts.test:runner: node --import tsx --test electron/aio-process-runner.test.ts src/output-search.test.ts src/welcome-messages.test.ts src/app-log.test.ts src/cloud-manager-context.test.ts
